about.title: What is SafeConnect?
about.text: In an emergency, finding the right number takes time you do not have. SafeConnect uses your location to show the official numbers for your police station, union council, village police and hospital, in the order to call them. Noakhali and Cox's Bazar now, the whole country later.
points: Every number comes from an official *.gov.bd website, with its source link. The sources are re-checked every week.
After one visit, the numbers, area search, "Find help near me" and sending your location by SMS work without internet.
Your family's numbers stay on your phone. We collect no personal data.

faq.title: Good to know
items: Where do the numbers come from?
From the official websites (*.gov.bd) of districts, upazilas, unions and municipalities. Each number shows its source link and the date the source was checked.
What if a number is wrong?
On an area page, tap "Report a wrong number" under the number (you need to sign in). We check it against the official source and fix it if it is wrong. In an emergency, call 999 first.

Yes. Open the site once with internet; after that all numbers, area search, "Find help near me" and SMS work without internet. Only WhatsApp, maps, source links and reporting a wrong number need internet. Calls and SMS still need mobile signal.

Nowhere. Your family's numbers and last area stay in your phone's browser. Your location is sent only when you send it. If you turn on "Update my area automatically", your location is checked on this phone only, and only the area name is saved.
Noakhali and Cox's Bazar now. More districts come step by step once their data is checked. National numbers like 999, 109 and 333 work everywhere.
